hero.subtitle: Experience the legendary taste of our iconic Benne Dose and timeless South Indian delicacies, cherished since 1920.

about.title: The Central Tiffin Room Legacy: Over 100 Years of Tradition
about.paragraph1: Central Tiffin Room, affectionately known as CTR, is more than just an eatery; it's a legendary institution deeply woven into the heart and history of Old Bengaluru. Established in 1920, we have proudly delighted generations of patrons for over a century with our iconic Dosas, Idlis, and a variety of authentic South Indian delicacies. Our dishes have remained timeless favorites, embodying culinary mastery and cherished tradition passed down through the visionary Subramanyam brothers to the current 3rd Generation baton carriers, Mr. Sandesh Poojari and Ganesh S Poojari.
about.paragraph2: At Central Tiffin Room, we are renowned for 'Bengaluru’s Best Benne Dose' – truly the emotion that holds Old Bengaluru together, delivering the essence of nostalgia in every bite. For over 104 years, we've cast our vintage charm, meticulously retaining the original taste and quality that has made our Benne Doses a legendary delight in the old town of Bengaluru. Our commitment to authentic flavors and the boundless love of our patrons is the heart of our enduring legacy.
